growth.chunk_alloc: when the map has a free slot after the finish node, allocate one 0x200-byte chunk via operator new, store it at map[finish node + 1], store the element in the last slot of the old finish chunk, then move the finish iterator to the new chunk at slot 0
growth.free_slots_rule: free slots after the finish node = map size - finish node index; 1 or fewer takes the map reallocation, 2 or more takes the chunk allocation
growth.length_error: deque size exactly 0xfffffffffffffff throws the length error; size = (finish node - start node - 1) * 64 + finish slot used + start chunk remaining
growth.map_grow: new map of 2 * (map size + 1) slots, or 3 slots when the map is empty; node pointers centred at new map + ((new slots - span - 2) // 2) * 8, copied with memmove (one qword copied directly when the byte count is exactly 8), old map freed with a sized delete of old size * 8
growth.map_recenter: when 2 * (span + 2) < map size, the node pointers move inside the same map to map + ((map size - span - 2) // 2) * 8 with memmove, and no new map is allocated
growth.map_size_overflow: new slot count above 0xfffffffffffffff throws bad-array-new-length when the count shifted right by 61 is nonzero, else bad-alloc
growth.trigger: append when the finish slot is 63, the last slot of the finish chunk
